shortDescription: Configures disk group policies on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: configuration_mode
options.description: Disk group configuration mode. Choose one of the following: automatic - Automatically configures the disks in the disk group. manual - Enables you to manually configure the disks in the disk group.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the storage profile. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: drive_type
options.description: Specify the drive type to use in the drive group. This can be one of the following: unspecified — Selects the first available drive type, and applies that to all drives in the group. HDD — Hard disk drive SSD — Solid state drive Option only applies when configuration mode is automatic.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: manual_disks
options.description: List of manually configured disks. Options are only used when you choose manual configuration_mode.

options.name: min_drive_size
options.description: Specify the minimum drive size or unspecified to allow all drive sizes. This can be from 0 to 10240 GB. Option only applies when configuration mode is automatic.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the disk group policy. This name can be between 1 and 16 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the policy is created.

options.name: num_ded_hot_spares
options.description: Specify the number of hot spares for the disk group. This can be from 0 to 24. Option only applies when configuration mode is automatic.

options.name: num_drives
options.description: Specify the number of drives for the disk group. This can be from 0 to 24. Option only applies when configuration mode is automatic.

options.name: num_glob_hot_spares
options.description: Specify the number of global hot spares for the disk group. This can be from 0 to 24. Option only applies when configuration mode is automatic.

options.name: org_dn
options.description: The distinguished name (dn) of the organization where the resource is assigned.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: raid_level
options.description: The RAID level for the disk group policy. This can be one of the following: stripe - UCS Manager shows RAID 0 Striped mirror - RAID 1 Mirrored mirror-stripe - RAID 10 Mirrored and Striped stripe-parity - RAID 5 Striped Parity stripe-dual-parity - RAID 6 Striped Dual Parity stripe-parity-stripe - RAID 50 Striped Parity and Striped stripe-dual-parity-stripe - RAID 60 Striped Dual Parity and Striped

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the disk group policy. If C(present), will verify that the disk group policy is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify that the disk group policy is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_remaining_disks
options.description: Specifies whether you can use all the remaining disks in the disk group or not. Option only applies when configuration mode is automatic.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: virtual_drive
options.description: Configuration of virtual drive options.
